assertion_results.text: For each task created, a description digest is produced — evidenced by a separate digest file (e.g., task-N-digest.md), a digest entry in the impact map, or a '[sdlc-workflow] Description digest: sha256-md:<64-char-hex>' marker in any output file. The digest must contain a format-tagged SHA-256 hash — exactly 64 lowercase hex characters prefixed by 'sha256-md:' or 'sha256-adf:', not a placeholder, abbreviated value, or example string
assertion_results.evidence: Separate digest files exist for all 5 tasks (task-1-digest.md through task-5-digest.md). However, all contain the placeholder text 'sha256-adf:<computed-after-jira-creation>' instead of an actual 64-character lowercase hex hash. For example, task-1-digest.md line 16: '[sdlc-workflow] Description digest: sha256-adf:<computed-after-jira-creation>'. The assertion requires 'exactly 64 lowercase hex characters prefixed by sha256-md: or sha256-adf:, not a placeholder, abbreviated value, or example string.' The value '<computed-after-jira-creation>' is explicitly a placeholder.
